card.name: Start of PATIENTS in capitals
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word patient or patients when it is split up, mostly in ALL-CAPS headings and warnings (PAT before IENTS). It also fires on 'at' in 'P at ients' in spaced-out headings.

modes.label: All-caps PAT
modes.description: PAT begins PATIENT or PATIENTS in capitalized warning headings and sentences.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY<< PAT>>IENTS WITH DEMENTIA-RELATED

modes.label: Split lowercase patients
modes.description: The 'at' piece inside a broken-up 'Patients' in a section heading.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Decreased Clinical Response in A dult cIAI P<< at>>ients with B aseline CrC l

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the word as patient or patients (also customer), and away from participants or individuals.
card.plain: It spots a capitalized or broken-up 'patients' that is only half written and predicts the rest of the word.
